attempted_claim: Let A(r,2r)={z:r<=|z|<=2r} on the mesh-1 triangular lattice at p=1/2 and let D(r) be the probability that A(r,2r) contains an open circuit separating inner from outer boundary. Let c_star in (0,1) be the CLE(6) probability that the modulus-log-2 annulus contains a loop separating its boundaries as characterized by the cited annulus crossing formula with explicit numeric enclosure logged in the audit. Then for all r>=50, |D(r)-c_star|<=0.5 r^{-0.10}, a nonvacuous discrete-to-continuum loop-transfer rate.
decisive_failure: No complete TARGET or EMERGENT_FINDING result is claimed. The compact-range uniform control (D(r)<=0.002 via textbook RSW duality plus c_star~=7.54e-05 from the published eta formula) covers only r in [50,~6e23] and lacks the decaying explicit rate needed for the unbounded tail; the small Monte Carlo probe tested the wrong observable and is non-rigorous. Full resolution needs a new explicit-constant annulus-circuit rate or a certified violation sequence, both beyond the available budget.
